llm_response.reason: The site mimics a legitimate fashion brand (Essentiel Antwerp) using an unrelated domain, lacks verifiable business, contact, and company identity information, and exhibits failed DNS resolution for main shopping subpages. It claims secure shopping and free shipping but does not post legally required company documentation. These match multiple scam characteristics including imitation of legitimate sites, ambiguous privacy notation, missing business info, and technical failures, consistent with Fake Online Shopping scams.
